text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-o-n-f-i-g-u-r-e-d s-i-g-n-a-l j-a-m-m-e-r s to b-l-o-c-k d-r-o-n-e n-a-v-i-g-a-t-i-o-n c-h-a-n-n-e-l-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g r-a-d-i-o l-o-g s b-e-h-i-n-d a-n-d i-g-n-o-r-i-n-g f-o-r-b-i-d-d-e-n i-n-t-e-r-f-e-r-e-n-c-e p-o-l-i-c-y.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-a-m-o-u-f-l-a-g-e-d t-h-e b-r-o-a-d-c-a-s-t a-s a g-e-n-e-r-i-c s-i-g-n-a-l f-a-i-l-u-r-e t-o m-i-m-i-c n-o-r-m-a-l o-p-e-r-a-t-i-o-n a-l-e-r-t-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g s-i-g-n-a-t-u-r-e m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a b-e-h-i-n-d a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g f-o-r-e-n-s-i-c r-e-v-i-e-w.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r r-o-u-t-e-d d-r-o-n-e s t-o a p-r-e-s-e-l-e-c-t-e-d d-r-o-p z-o-n-e, l-e-a-v-i-n-g g-p-s t-r-a-i-l r-e-c-o-r-d-s b-e-h-i-n-d a-n-d c-i-r-c-u-m-v-e-n-t-i-n-g f-l-i-g-h-t p-e-r-m-i-t c-h-e-c-k-s.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-o-l-l-e-c-t-e-d l-a-n-d-e-d p-a-r-c-e-l s f-r-o-m t-h-e s-t-a-g-e d-s t-o p-e r-i-m-e-t-e-r, l-e-a-v-i-n-g h-a-n-d-l-e b-a-s-s b-e-h-i-n-d a-n-d i-g-n-o-r-i-n-g p-r-o-p-e-r-t-y c-u-s-t-o-d-y v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-i-s-a-b-l-e-d l-o-c-a-t-i-o-n t-r-a-c-k-i-n-g o-n d-e-v-i-c-e s a-f-t-e r c-o-m-p-l-e-t-i-o-n, l-e-a-v-i-n-g t-e-m-p-o-r-a-l y a-c-t-i-v-i-t-y r-e-m-n-a-n-t-s b-e-h-i-n-d a-n-d b-y-p-a-s-s-i-n-g p-o-s-t i-n-c-i-d-e n o t i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
